questions.q: What is the main function of the vas deferens in the male reproductive system?
options: Transporting sperm from the epididymis to the urethra
questions.solution:
The vas deferens carries sperm away from the epididymis towards the urethra. Sperm formation itself takes place in the testes.
**Answer: Transporting sperm from the epididymis to the urethra**

questions.q: An atom has 11 protons, 11 electrons and 12 neutrons. What is the mass number of that atom?
questions.solution:
Mass number counts protons plus neutrons, not electrons. Thus 11 + 12 = 23.
**Answer: 23**

questions.q: An object is placed 30 cm in front of a concave mirror of focal length 15 cm. What will be the image distance v?
questions.solution:
Using the Cartesian sign convention, f = -15 cm and u = -30 cm. From 1/f = 1/v + 1/u, v = -30 cm. The real image forms in front of the mirror.
**Answer: –30 cm**

questions.q: Which of the following ensures genetic variation in sexually reproducing animals?
options: Offspring receive genes from both parents
questions.solution:
Sexual reproduction combines genetic material from two parents. Meiosis and fertilisation create new combinations of alleles in offspring.
**Answer: Offspring receive genes from both parents**

questions.q: Which of the following statements is NOT correct?
options: The angle of deviation is the angle between the incident ray and emergent ray.
In a prism, dispersion can occur if white light is used.
In a prism, the incident ray and emergent ray are always parallel.
In a prism, the emergent ray bends towards the base of the prism when the incident ray is coming from the base side.
questions.solution:
A prism generally changes the direction of a light ray, so its incident and emergent rays are not always parallel. The other statements describe deviation or dispersion.
**Answer: In a prism, the incident ray and emergent ray are always parallel.**

questions.q: Which gas is mainly responsible for the greenhouse effect and is released when fossil fuels are burned?
questions.solution:
Burning fossil fuels releases carbon dioxide. Increased atmospheric carbon dioxide strengthens the greenhouse effect.
**Answer: Carbon dioxide**

questions.q: According to Bohr's Model of atom, electrons revolve around the nucleus in ___________.
questions.solution:
Bohr’s model places electrons in discrete permitted orbits with fixed energies. It does not allow arbitrary or random orbits.
**Answer: discrete orbits**

questions.q: A net horizontal force of 20 N acts on a 4 kg block initially at rest for 5 s. What is the block’s final speed?
questions.solution:
Acceleration = force/mass = 20/4 = 5 m/s². Starting from rest, speed after five seconds = 5 × 5 = 25 m/s.
**Answer: 25 m/s**

questions.q: Which of the following correctly defines the amplitude of a wave?
options: The distance between two consecutive crests
The maximum displacement of the particle from its mean position
The number of vibrations per second
The speed with which the wave travels
questions.solution:
Amplitude is the maximum displacement from the mean position. The distance between successive crests is the wavelength.
**Answer: The maximum displacement of the particle from its mean position**

questions.q: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT about uniform motion?
options: The speed varies continuously with time
The body covers equal distances in equal intervals of time
questions.solution:
Uniform rectilinear motion has constant velocity and covers equal distances in equal times. A continuously changing speed contradicts uniform motion.
**Answer: The speed varies continuously with time**

questions.q: What is the formula of formic acid?
options: C ₂ H ₄ O ₂
questions.solution:
Formic acid is methanoic acid, with structural formula HCOOH. The COOH group identifies it as a carboxylic acid.
**Answer: HCOOH**

questions.q: Which of the following statements is true about magnetic field lines?
options: Field lines inside a magnet move from north to south.
Field lines outside a magnet move from north to south.
Magnetic field is weaker where lines are close.
questions.solution:
Outside a bar magnet, field lines run from the north pole to the south pole. Inside the magnet they return from south to north, forming closed loops.
**Answer: Field lines outside a magnet move from north to south.**

questions.q: Which of the following carbon compounds burns with a blue, non-sooty flame under normal conditions?
questions.solution:
Ethanol typically burns with a clean blue flame when enough oxygen is available. Heavier fuels are more prone to producing soot.
**Answer: Ethanol**

questions.q: What is the role of lysosomes in a cell?
questions.solution:
Lysosomes contain digestive enzymes. They break down unwanted material, worn-out cell components and foreign particles.
**Answer: To digest foreign material**

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT considered an organic compound?
questions.solution:
Carbonates such as sodium carbonate are conventionally classified as inorganic compounds despite containing carbon. Acetic acid, ethanol and methane are organic.
**Answer: Sodium carbonate (Na2CO3)**

questions.q: During the process of electrolytic refining of metals, on passing the current through the electrolyte, the impure metal from the _____________ dissolves into the electrolyte.
questions.solution:
The impure metal is the anode in electrolytic refining. Metal atoms dissolve from it and deposit as purer metal on the cathode.
**Answer: anode**

questions.q: An object is thrown straight up and reaches a maximum height of 20 m. If we take g = 10 m/sec 2 , what was the initial speed of the object when it was thrown?
questions.solution:
At the highest point, final velocity is zero. Using u² = 2gh gives u = √(2 × 10 × 20) = 20 m/s.
**Answer: 20 m/sec**

questions.q: Which of the following observations confirms that a solution is acidic?
options: Methyl orange: red, Phenolphthalein: pink, Litmus: red
Methyl orange: red, Phenolphthalein: colourless, Litmus: red
Methyl orange: yellow, Phenolphthalein: pink, Litmus: blue
Methyl orange: yellow, Phenolphthalein: colourless, Litmus: blue
questions.solution:
An acidic solution turns methyl orange red and litmus red, while phenolphthalein remains colourless. Pink phenolphthalein indicates an alkaline solution.
**Answer: Methyl orange: red, Phenolphthalein: colourless, Litmus: red**

questions.q: Two wires of the same material have equal lengths but their cross-sectional areas are in the ratio 1 : 4. The ratio of their resistances will be:
questions.solution:
For the same material and length, R = ρL/A, so resistance is inversely proportional to area. Areas 1 : 4 give resistances 4 : 1.
**Answer: 4 : 1**

questions.q: A machine does ‘W’ joule work in time ‘t’ seconds. The power ‘P’ watt of the machine is given correctly by which of the following relations?
questions.solution:
Power is the rate of doing work. Divide work W by elapsed time t to obtain P = W/t.
**Answer: P = W/t**

questions.q: Based on function, which of the following combinations represent all types of animal tissues found in humans?
options: Epithelial tissue, Connective tissue, Muscular tissue and Nervous tissue
Epithelial tissue, Connective tissue and Reproductive tissue
Epithelial tissue, Connective tissue and Skeletal tissue
Epithelial tissue, Muscular tissue and Glandular tissue
questions.solution:
The four main animal tissue classes are epithelial, connective, muscular and nervous. Bone and blood are included within connective tissue.
**Answer: Epithelial tissue, Connective tissue, Muscular tissue and Nervous tissue**

questions.q: Which plastids contain pigments that give plants their yellow, orange or red colours?
questions.solution:
Chromoplasts contain coloured pigments such as carotenoids. They give many fruits and flowers their yellow, orange or red appearance.
**Answer: Chromoplasts**

questions.q: Which of the following is a key goal of conserving forests and biodiversity?
options: To allow more industrial use of forests
questions.solution:
Conservation aims to preserve biodiversity and the ecological systems supporting it. Tourism and park expansion can be tools, but are not the basic conservation goal.
**Answer: To preserve inherited biodiversity**

questions.q: Which property of isobars is always different?
questions.solution:
Isobars have equal mass numbers but different atomic numbers. The atomic number counts protons and identifies the element.
**Answer: Atomic number**

questions.q: If tall (T) is dominant over short (t), and round seeds (R) are dominant over wrinkled (r), identify the genotype of a plant that shows short height and round seeds.
questions.solution:
Short height requires tt because t is recessive. Round seeds require at least one R. Among the options, ttRR is the only short, round genotype.
**Answer: ttRR**

questions.q: According to the India BioEconomy Report 2025, how much is India's BioEconomy valued at in 2024?
questions.solution:
India BioEconomy Report 2025 valued the country’s bioeconomy at US$165.7 billion for 2024. The report year and valuation year differ.
**Answer: $165.7 billion**

questions.q: In which of the following cities was the inauguration of the Recognition of Prior Learning – Certification in Indian Sign Language Interpretation (RPL–CISLI) programme held in August 2025?
questions.solution:
The RPL–CISLI programme inauguration in August 2025 took place in New Delhi. It concerned recognition and certification of prior learning in Indian Sign Language interpretation.
**Answer: New Delhi**

questions.q: Which Indian state topped the 'Environment' theme in the State of States rankings of the State of India’s Environment 2025 report released by the Centre for Science and Environment (CSE)?
questions.solution:
Andhra Pradesh topped the Environment theme in the State of States rankings cited from the State of India’s Environment 2025 report.
**Answer: Andhra Pradesh**

questions.q: Who scored the highest individual score in a single innings during IPL 2025?
questions.solution:
Abhishek Sharma scored 141 for Sunrisers Hyderabad against Punjab Kings. It was the highest individual innings in IPL 2025.
**Answer: Abhishek Sharma**

questions.q: Which of the following countries hosted the largest yoga session with over 1.5 million participants in 2025?
questions.solution:
India hosted the mass yoga event with more than 1.5 million participants referred to in the paper. The question concerns the 2025 event.
**Answer: India**

questions.q: Which athlete won the Arjuna Award for boxing in January 2025?
questions.solution:
Saweety Boora received the Arjuna Award for boxing in the January 2025 awards. The award recognised her sporting achievements.
**Answer: Saweety Boora**

questions.q: In June 2025, the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance, convened a high-level meeting co-chaired by M Nagaraju, Secretary, Department of Financial Services and T Rabi Sankar, Deputy Governor, RBI at New Delhi, on scaling up ULI. What is the full form of ULI?
questions.solution:
ULI stands for Unified Lending Interface. It is designed to make relevant borrower data more readily available for credit decisions.
**Answer: Unified Lending Interface**

questions.q: Which of the following organised the Summer Book Writing Festival in 2025?
questions.solution:
BriBooks organised the Summer Book Writing Festival in 2025. The event encouraged participants to write and publish books.
**Answer: BriBooks**

questions.q: What was the name of the bilateral naval exercise between the Indian Navy and the French Navy held in March 2025?
questions.solution:
VARUNA is the bilateral naval exercise between India and France. Its 2025 edition took place in March.
**Answer: VARUNA**

questions.q: Who is the Chairperson of the 16 th Finance Commission of India?
questions.solution:
Arvind Panagariya was appointed chairperson of the 16th Finance Commission. N. K. Singh chaired the 15th Commission.
**Answer: Arvind Panagariya**

questions.q: Which of the following novels won the 2025 Pulitzer Prize for Fiction?
questions.solution:
James by Percival Everett won the 2025 Pulitzer Prize for Fiction. The novel retells the world of Huckleberry Finn from Jim’s perspective.
**Answer: James**

questions.q: On 20 th May, 2025, the Supreme Court (SC) reinstated the requirement of how many years of legal practice for law graduates to apply for civil judge (junior division) posts, reversing its 2002 decision?
questions.solution:
The Supreme Court restored a minimum three-year legal-practice requirement for entry-level civil judge recruitment in May 2025. It applies to subsequent recruitment processes as specified in the judgment.
**Answer: 3 years**

questions.q: Which party won the by-election to the Visavadar Assembly Constituency (Gujarat) in June 2025?
questions.solution:
The Aam Aadmi Party won the Visavadar Assembly by-election in June 2025. Its candidate was Gopal Italia.
**Answer: Aam Aadmi Party**

questions.q: Which among the following civic suggestions did Karnataka’s Deputy Chief Minister give in September 2025 to improve governance quality in Bengaluru?
options: Pay taxes, declare assets, hide nothing
questions.solution:
The suggestion was to pay taxes, declare assets and conceal nothing. It linked citizens’ transparency and tax compliance with civic governance.
**Answer: Pay taxes, declare assets, hide nothing**

questions.q: Who set the men’s 10,000 m record of 27:00.22 at TEN 2025 meet?
questions.solution:
Gulveer Singh ran 27:00.22 at The TEN in 2025, setting the Indian men’s 10,000 m record.
**Answer: Gulveer Singh**

questions.q: World Environment Day was observed on 5 June 2025 with a special focus to end which of the following?
questions.solution:
World Environment Day 2025 focused on ending plastic pollution. The theme encouraged action against waste and contamination from plastics.
**Answer: Plastic Pollution**

questions.q: How many prototypes of the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) does India plan to develop before starting series production?
questions.solution:
The AMCA development plan specified five prototypes before series production. Prototype testing precedes production clearance.
**Answer: Five**

questions.q: Who among the following was appointed as Executive Director of the Reserve Bank of India in March 2025 to look after Department of Statistics and Information Management and Financial Stability Department?
questions.solution:
Dr. Ajit Ratnakar Joshi was appointed RBI Executive Director in March 2025, with responsibilities including statistics and financial stability.
**Answer: Dr. Ajit Ratnakar Joshi**

questions.q: India is drafting its first comprehensive framework, National Adaptation Plan (NAP), to be submitted to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) by September 2025 in compliance with the _____.
questions.solution:
The National Adaptation Plan is associated with climate adaptation commitments under the Paris Agreement and the UNFCCC process.
**Answer: Paris Agreement**
